protocol.name: hyprture_v1

description.summary: live views of workspaces and windows, drawn by the compositor

protocol.description: An aperture is a rectangle of a client's surface in which the compositor draws a source (a workspace, a window or a monitor) live. The client never receives the pixels: it says where the view goes, and the compositor composites it right above the surface's own content, clipped to the surface. Meant for shell clients (bars, overviews, switchers).

request.name: destroy
request.description: Apertures created from it are not affected.

request.name: get_aperture

description.summary: create an aperture on a surface

request.description: Creates an aperture on `parent`, initially without a source and without a destination, so it shows nothing. A surface can have any number of apertures; they are drawn in creation order.

interface.name: hyprture_aperture_v1

description.summary: a live view in a rectangle of a surface

interface.description: All its state is double-buffered: requests take effect on the parent surface's next commit. If the parent surface is destroyed, the aperture becomes inert; destroy it.

request.name: set_source_workspace
request.description: Shows the workspace with this id, as laid out on its monitor, whether or not it is visible. Shows nothing while no such workspace exists.

request.name: set_source_window
request.description: Shows the window with this address, in hexadecimal as the compositor reports it ("0x5a1b…"), at its own size, with its decorations.

request.name: set_source_monitor
request.description: Shows the active workspace of the monitor with this name, with its shell (wallpaper, layer surfaces).

request.name: set_destination
request.description: The rectangle, in surface-local coordinates, the source is scaled into. A source whose aspect ratio differs is fitted inside it, centered. Zero width or height hides the aperture.

request.name: set_radius
request.description: Corner radius of the view, in surface-local units.

request.name: set_live
request.description: Live (the default): the view follows its source every frame. Still: it is drawn once, then again only when its state changes.

event.name: source
event.description: Sent when the source resolves, or when its size changes: the size of the source in logical units (its monitor's for a workspace), so the client can lay the destination out with its aspect ratio. Zero when the source doesn't exist.
